description: This file defines an 'ApprovalService' class that manages submission approvals, including electronic signature validation, Segregation of Duties enforcement, and evidence package management within an approval workflow system. It contains exception classes, and public interface methods for verifying e-signatures and processing approvals, along with various internal validation and audit mechanisms.
